original.target_description: Study 7, real-life recalled offenses among introductory psychology students; two-way gender × questionnaire-order ANOVA, interaction predicting the TRIM Vengefulness subscale (capability–empathy items before versus after TRIM).

n.sample_role: Participants in the gender × condition Vengefulness analysis; Table 3 lists cell counts of 25 and 20 in control, and 58 and 52 in capability–empathy condition.
n.exclusions: No Study 7 exclusions reported; Table 3 cell counts match the participant counts.

n.quote:
Participants (83 men, 72 women) were taking an introductory
psychology course at a private research university in Ohio.

es.location: Table 3, p. 506 (PDF p. 12), Study 7, Vengefulness row, Interaction column; F(η²) column heading.

p.location: Table 3, p. 506 (PDF p. 12), Study 7 Vengefulness interaction marked **; table note p. 507 (PDF p. 13).

notes: Published article title and DOI match supplied reference. Selected the gender × priming interaction for the Vengefulness subscale, as identified by the men-and-women locator and Study 7 Results; the whole-TRIM interaction is a distinct, marginal test (Table 3). The male simple effect is also distinct (t = 2.92, η² = .10, p < .01) and is not combined with the interaction. Analytic participant counts are retained as printed by gender; no total or effect metric was calculated. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service. Replication and reported_success unassigned.
